sources.title: Minutes of Northbridge Borough Council, Cabinet (cabinet), 26 February 2025 — item 7 Waste and recycling service — party in overall control of the council on the date: Labour
passages: The Cabinet agreed that weekly collections of food waste would begin in April 2026.
Members noted that the cost of the new service would be met from the capital programme.

sources.title: Minutes of Eastmere District Council, Full Council (full council), 4 March 2025 — item 12 Budget — party in overall control of the council on the date: Liberal Democrats
passages: The Council resolved to keep fortnightly collections of general waste.
An amendment to bring in a charge for garden waste was lost.

sources.title: Minutes of Northbridge Borough Council, Overview and Scrutiny Committee (overview and scrutiny committee), 11 March 2025 — item 4 Recycling rates — party in overall control of the council on the date: Labour
passages: The Committee heard that the recycling rate had fallen to 34 per cent.
